description:
Situated in the popular residential area of St Mary’s, Graham Road is ideally positioned for access to Royal South Hants Hospital, Southampton city centre and a wide range of local amenities, shops, schools and transport links. The area is predominantly characterised by Victorian terraced housing, making this an appealing location for first-time buyers, families and investors alike. The accommodation is arranged over two floors and briefly comprises an entrance hallway, a bay-fronted living room currently utilised as a fourth bedroom, a spacious kitchen/dining area, inner lobby, ground-floor bathroom and three further well-proportioned bedrooms to the first floor. On entering the property, the welcoming entrance hallway provides access to the principal rooms, with stairs rising to the first floor. To the right is the front reception room, featuring an attractive bay window and currently being used as a bedroom, providing excellent flexibility depending on the purchaser’s requirements. Further along the hallway is the kitchen/dining room, fitted with a range of white eye and base-level units with work surfaces over. Integrated appliances include an oven and gas hob with extractor hood, with additional space provided for a washing machine and fridge freezer. The kitchen leads through to an inner lobby, which benefits from a side door providing access to the rear garden. A further door leads into the three-piece family bathroom, comprising a P-shaped bath with shower over, wash hand basin and WC, complemented by an obscured double-glazed window. To the first floor are three well-proportioned bedrooms, offering comfortable and versatile accommodation for family living, guests or home working. 

Externally, the rear garden features a decked seating area, raised planted borders to both sides and a further area laid to lawn. The garden is fully enclosed by fencing, providing a pleasant outdoor space for relaxation and entertaining. The property is offered for sale with no forward chain and represents an excellent opportunity for a range of buyers. Whether you are looking for your first home, a family property or an investment opportunity, this versatile Victorian terrace is well worth viewing.
